panels.description: Prometheus targets currently reporting for the selected Frontend services.
panels.title: Frontend targets

panels.description: Prometheus targets currently reporting for the selected model groups and roles.
panels.title: Model servers

panels.description: Frontend responses started per second over five minutes.
panels.title: Requests / s

panels.description: HTTP responses that started with 5xx divided by all started responses. Streaming failures after headers are not included.
panels.title: 5xx ratio

panels.description: Prompt tokens processed per second by the selected model servers.
panels.title: Prompt tokens / s

panels.description: Generated tokens produced per second by the selected model servers.
panels.title: Output tokens / s

panels.description: Requests waiting for frontend admission to a scaling target.
panels.title: Queued requests

panels.description: One when any selected model-server has fallen back to Pod-scoped temporary cache storage. No value means the selected groups do not use RuntimeCache.
panels.title: Temporary RuntimeCache

panels.description: Frontend response starts grouped by HTTP status class.
panels.title: Request rate by status

panels.description: Frontend response starts grouped by HTTP endpoint.
panels.title: Request rate by endpoint

panels.description: Time until the Frontend handler produces HTTP response headers. This excludes SSE body delivery; it is neither TTFT nor full-stream duration.
panels.title: Response-start latency

panels.description: Requests waiting for runtime preparation or backend dispatch, grouped by scaling-target kind.
panels.title: Admission queue

panels.description: Successfully completed model-server requests grouped by finish reason.
panels.title: Completed request rate

panels.description: Prompt and generated token throughput for the selected model servers.
panels.title: Token throughput

panels.description: Requests running in vLLM execution batches or waiting in its scheduler.
panels.title: Scheduler state

panels.description: Maximum per-model-group quantile from Frontend handler entry, after JSON decoding, to the model-server terminal output. Excludes downstream client body consumption. Frontend and model-server clocks must be synchronized.
panels.title: Generation completion latency

panels.description: Maximum per-model-group TTFT quantile from Frontend handler entry, after JSON decoding, to the first token received by model-server. Chat and completion requests share this origin.
panels.title: Time to first token

panels.description: Maximum per-model-group output-token latency quantile. This is not a cluster-wide quantile.
panels.title: Time per output token

panels.description: Maximum per-model-group gap between consecutive output tokens. Unlike time per output token, it is measured per token rather than averaged over the request.
panels.title: Inter-token latency

panels.description: P90 time a request spends waiting for the scheduler, in prefill, and in decode.
panels.title: Request time by stage

panels.description: Requests preempted per second because KV-cache blocks ran out. Sustained preemption precedes the KV-cache pressure alert.
panels.title: Preemptions

panels.description: Distribution of prompt tokens per request over time.
panels.title: Prompt length

panels.description: Distribution of generated tokens per request over time.
panels.title: Output length

panels.description: Highest in-engine KV-cache utilization grouped by model role. The dashed line is the KV-cache pressure alert threshold.
panels.title: KV Cache utilization

panels.description: Average local and external Prefix Cache token hit ratios across selected model groups.
panels.title: Prefix Cache hit ratio

panels.description: Healthy KV event sources divided by configured sources. Disabled or unavailable indexing reports zero.
panels.title: KV index source health

panels.description: Mounted RuntimeCache filesystem utilization. Series are absent for model groups without a RuntimeCache.
panels.title: RuntimeCache utilization

panels.description: Filesystem space available to model-server processes using a RuntimeCache.
panels.title: RuntimeCache available space

panels.description: Mean utilization of Foretoken-attributed GPUs by vendor and node across workload namespaces. Shared devices are counted once; devices without Foretoken Pod attribution are excluded.

targets.expr: avg by(vendor, node) (max by(vendor, node, device_id) (foretoken:accelerator_gpu_utilization_ratio))

panels.title: Node mean GPU utilization

panels.description: Mean memory utilization of Foretoken-attributed GPUs by vendor and node across workload namespaces. Shared devices are counted once; devices without Foretoken Pod attribution are excluded.

targets.expr: avg by(vendor, node) (max by(vendor, node, device_id) (foretoken:accelerator_gpu_memory_usage_ratio))

panels.title: Node mean GPU memory utilization

panels.description: Utilization of each Foretoken-attributed GPU.
panels.title: GPU utilization by device

panels.description: Memory utilization of each Foretoken-attributed GPU.
panels.title: GPU memory by device

panels.description: Power draw of each Foretoken-attributed NVIDIA GPU.
panels.title: GPU power by device

panels.description: Temperature of each Foretoken-attributed NVIDIA GPU.
panels.title: GPU temperature by device

panels.description: CPU cores consumed by Frontend and model-server containers in the selected namespaces.
panels.title: Serving CPU usage

panels.description: Working-set memory used by Frontend and model-server containers in the selected namespaces.
panels.title: Serving memory usage

panels.description: Selection results by workflow round. A selection failure is not an HTTP status; a request can involve several rounds.
panels.title: Routing outcomes

panels.description: P99 filter, scorer and picker execution time, aggregated from histogram buckets across selected Frontend replicas.
panels.title: Routing stage latency

panels.description: Mean available, filtered and selectable candidate counts. Selectable counts include data-parallel ranks.
panels.title: Routing candidates

panels.description: Controller-runtime errors per second. This section observes the platform controller independently of workload namespace filters.
panels.title: Reconcile errors

panels.description: P99 reconciliation time by controller; this is control-plane work, not inference request latency.
panels.title: Reconcile latency

panels.description: Queued reconciliations. Current replica counts are deduplicated rather than added across controller replicas.
panels.title: Controller workqueues

panels.description: Latest published recommendation, adjusted target and applied desired capacity. A missing recommendation means the decision algorithm did not provide one.
panels.title: Replica decisions

panels.description: Ready and routable capacity published by the autoscaler, compared with applied desired replicas.
panels.title: Serving capacity

panels.description: Elapsed time since the last observation and evaluation; age keeps increasing if reconciliation stops. Missing observation series means no usable observation was published.
panels.title: Observation and evaluation age

panels.description: Current trigger, decision and adjustment outcomes from ModelService status. Reasons are bounded status codes, not log messages.
panels.title: Latest autoscaling stage
